patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): If you happen to have a naturally uncensored version of the game (for example; from MangaGamer), all you have to do is start that version up once. That's it, the Steam version will automatically fix itself. Otherwise, grab the patch file from below. Put this file in the same location as the "HuniePop.exe" executable ("HuniePop.app" on Mac) and then start the game up. That's it. To quickly access t It's working if: In the bottom left corner of the main menu it should say 'Uncensored'. uncensorpat.ch checked this patch on PC.
